decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 04/04/05, the erection of a single storey detached outbuilding measuring 12.0m wide, 6.0m deep and 4.0m high to the top of a ridged roof was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
The development falls within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class E of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995.

Condition : 2 - Informative:

The detached outbuilding hereby found to be lawful shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the single-family dwellinghouse known as 25 Shelley Crescent and for no other purpose (i.e. it shall not be used as a bedroom, living room, office or other business use or as a separate dwelling and should not include toilet, bathroom or kitchen facilities).
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the proposed erection of a single storey outbuilding to rear garden for use as a playroom/utility room.
